title: MedRiskEval: Medical Risk Evaluation Benchmark of Language Models, On the Importance of User Perspectives in Healthcare Settings
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on medical safety risks, including a 'Discrimination' category that, based on the provided examples, pertains to gender and weight, not religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on medical risk evaluation.
